title: Dual direct image is finite locally free
statement: Under the hypotheses and universal Picard direct-image rank condition of lem-sc-picard-cup-product-criterion, the direct image of the pulled-back dual module is finite locally free.

source.place: final two proof paragraphs, cup product and local dual bases, before the determinant-open assertion

proof.text: Use the local finite-free rank decomposition and dual-basis argument described in the Stacks Project proof.

proof_origin.place: final two proof paragraphs, cup product and local dual bases, before the determinant-open assertion

mathlib_searches.query: For a proper flat family with universal pushforward of the structure sheaf equal to the structure sheaf and universally rank matched direct images, the transpose of cup product between the direct images of a vector bundle and its dual is an isomorphism if and only if the adjunction counit is an isomorphism

The cup product pairing between the direct images of a vector bundle and its dual is perfect if and only if the pullback pushforward evaluation counit is invertible, under equal rank and base change assumptions
